agent_priors_used: agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): local continuation is a real failure mode of output-injecting agents; inherited next_questions create path dependence, so a lane's handoff is treated as local evidence rather than an agenda.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark comparison between a treatment and a comparator is uninformative until the treatment arm is live and separable from the comparator by construction; liveness and causal attribution must precede any efficacy claim.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): a measurement instrument validated only against interventions authored by the detector's own author has an unmeasured construct boundary and should not be trusted for arbitrary real-world changes until an out-of-author change is detected.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): cryptographic/server-minted action tokens are a priori near-irreducible, so the informative physics question is the prevalence of predictable vs observation-bound value classes across a population, not the value of any single token.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): external dependencies (a model credential) that are unavailable to the factory should not gate the critical path when a credential-free proxy can still advance the same decision, but the dependency itself should be actively resolved or declared unresolvable.

agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): pre-freeze attainability and control-liveness must be checked before freeze; a large fraction of the program's MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcomes were unsatisfiable frozen branches rather than scientific negatives, so new mandates require arithmetic attainability and control-liveness certificates before freeze.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Alternatives were assessed. The parent handoff proposed a query-parameter perturbation measurement with an intervention-free repeat-fetch arm; that repairs the same observable class the last packet already found rank/magnitude-non-identifiable from HTTP signatures, and the degraded Scout's echo of it carries no fresh external evidence. Another estimator refinement is precisely the tunnel the flag and the audit warn against. C-MEAS-VALID is the strongest claim but its remaining scope bound is owned by Runtime. C-CROSSSITE presupposes executable cross-site mechanisms that do not exist yet. The server-minted-value predictability question is the most promising physics direction because it is materially new, cheap, and directly informs the persist-values-versus-procedures decision.
allocation.question: On a frozen population of credential-free public sites that mint server-side action-gating values (CSRF/session/one-time tokens) which vary across independent fresh sessions with disjoint cookie jars: what is the prevalence, per site and pooled with site-clustered intervals, of value classes that are PREDICTABLE from observable context - the previous value, issue order, session identity, or embedded counter/timestamp/structure - beyond a frozen irreducibility null calibrated before freeze to have demonstrated power and separable from a memory baseline that merely repeats the last observed value? Pre-register a falsifier satisfiable in BOTH directions and an arithmetic attainability certificate: if a material fraction of minted values is predictable beyond the calibrated null, then a freshness/repair engine can anticipate or cheaply re-derive the next valid value and value-level persistence has a measurable surface; if predictable values are at or below a preregistered prevalence floor, then server-minted state on this substrate class is irreducibly observation-bound and the architecture must persist procedures and paths and re-observe values fresh. Every pre-freeze pilot, power value and control status must be written literally inside spec.json before freeze, and branch precedence must be frozen so that an instrument failure is reported as MEASUREMENT_INVALID and never as FALSIFIES.
allocation.rationale: Physics is flagged as a local attractor (12 of its last 14 experiments on C-WEB-DYNAMICS) and the audit recommends parking it unless a materially new observable appears. The already-directed pre-freeze PIVOT is exactly such a new observable: server-minted value-sequence predictability is a different object from the repeatedly-failed response-signature density/divergence estimators (which the Codex retired because rank/magnitude is not identifiable from an HTTP signature), it is credential-free and cheap, it carries a both-directions falsifier, and its outcome is decision-changing for the architecture (persist values versus persist procedures/paths and re-observe). Continuing it is therefore justified on the merits rather than by inertia.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's objective is unchanged: demonstrate that a real external agent's cost per successful Web task tracks residual novelty rather than full task length. The Codex establishes bounded ingredients (C-PARAM-INHERIT EXPERIMENTAL; C-MEAS-VALID EXPERIMENTAL at an authorship-separated real-Chromium transport scope; C-FRESHNESS, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-CROSSSITE all HYPOTHESIS) but no packet yet validates the integrated chain observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end cost. Two lanes hold already-frozen transactions that must complete under their frozen design and are not redirected here: Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378 (hop-depth re-acquisition cost scaling, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY) and Graph EXP-GRAPH-37964565784 (GATE-C3-repaired freshness detection on four credential-free anchors, C-FRESHNESS). For the four pre-freeze lanes the binding priority order is: (1) make the shipped-kernel treatment arm demonstrably live and causally attributable on a real credential-free substrate (Product, C-PARAM-INHERIT) because a retrieval-vs-SPIDER comparison is meaningless until SPIDER executes an inherited mechanism at a non-zero rate; (2) remove the last scope bound on the strongest instrument, so downstream drift/freshness work can trust it (Runtime, C-MEAS-VALID); (3) find whether a programmatically invocable model endpoint and external comparator baselines exist so the four-arm external benchmark can finally run, or establish that it cannot (Intel, C-LLM-INHERIT); (4) obtain a genuinely new, cheap, both-directions Web-dynamics observable whose outcome decides value-vs-procedure persistence rather than re-run the retired estimator line (Physics, C-WEB-DYNAMICS). The four PREFREEZE lanes are not idle by omission; each is explicitly directed. I do not PARK or TERMINATE any lane: every banked direction is on the critical path or supplies a decision-changing orthogonal measurement, and the program's central claim is not yet decided in either direction.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (rc=75; no external reconnaissance and no Scout synthesis). Its brief is therefore a deterministic fallback: spider_evidence=[] and external_directional_context=[], and its candidate_directions are mechanically derived from lane parent handoffs rather than from new reconnaissance. I did not treat it as authority. Its only load-bearing contributions were (a) flagging physics, runtime, product and intel as PREFREEZE/stalled, which matches the machine snapshot and prompts the explicit reactivation decisions made here, and (b) independently echoing the Frontier hop-depth re-acquisition cost-scaling question, which the already-frozen transaction EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378 already implements. I did not adopt its physics candidate direction (a query-parameter perturbation repair of the same observable that the last physics packet already found rank/magnitude-non-identifiable from HTTP signatures): there is no fresh external evidence this cycle distinguishing it from the pre-freeze PIVOT to the server-minted-value predictability observable, and the fallback brief explicitly warns it is not evidence. Because no external intelligence was available, all decisions are grounded in the Codex, the claim registry, the machine snapshot and the agent priors above.
